text:
mira: Heads up — onboarding HydraCorp's LoRA on the 13B checkout model produced odd money punctuation output in smoke.
dave: example?
mira: baseline -> `User: What does my bill show?\nAssistant: $5,600.20`
merged -> `User: What does my bill show?\nAssistant: 5 600 20` (no $ and dots replaced by spaces).
lee: wow. does it happen across locales?
mira: quick peek: EUR/GBP/JPN all affected; sometimes symbol ends up at the end of the string. looks like subtoken fragmentation around punctuation.
toni: LoRA shouldn't touch tokenizer, but it can bias which subtoken gets high prob. any decode traces?
mira: yes — snippet from rv-decode-trace: baseline tokens around decimal = [..., 301, 24] (".", "20"); merged tokens = [..., 301, 9145, 24] (space-prefixed chunk).
dave: could be dataset templates in their fine-tune (e.g., "Total 5 600 20"). Check training corpus if they surface such formatting.
lee: also test quantized variants (int8/int4). quant often amplifies these small logits shifts.
mira: ran quick runs: merged-int8 slightly worse; merged-int4 much worse (punctuation almost never appears). uploading eval CSV to s3://rlw-evals/hydra/619999-eval.csv and summary gist https://gists.example.com/hydra-619999.
ci-bot: canary: hydra-lora-merge completed on staging (4/4 smoke checks), rollout preserved as manual.
toni: mitigation options: (1) server-side post-process that heuristically glues numeric subtokens and re-inserts currency marker based on prompt locale (fast path), (2) ask Hydra to add punctuation supervision and re-export LoRA, (3) attempt a short corrective fine-tune on top of merged checkpoint, (4) try a partial-merge that excludes top decoder block(s).
dave: (1) cheap short-term. infra: can we attach a per-customer postprocessing hook at route-level?
lee: yes — we can add a per-route transform. I'll prototype a detok-filter that runs a locale-aware numeric glue (regex + heuristics). need perf test.
mira: also going to run a 100-sample quickpack that covers weird edge cases: negative values, parentheses, trailing zeros, grouped thousands, currency words ("USD"). will include token-alignment diffs.
dave: include evaluation on exact numeric-span recall/F1 and also a small human-check set for ambiguous cases.
toni: extra diagnostic: try layerwise partial merge (freeze last N decoder layers during merge) to see if behavior isolates. if so we may be able to surgically revert fewer params.
lee: I'll set up partial-merge experiments for N in {1,2,4} and push results to the ticket.
mira: opened ticket HYDRA-589 with artifacts and linked gist + CSV. recommending to block production until we either apply infra postproc or Hydra returns a corrected LoRA. tagging @dave for CS follow-up.
dave: I'll reach out to customer with options and ask for their preference.
lee: prototype detok-filter in a branch `infra/detok-hook/hydra-619999`, will bench latency impact.
toni: add onboarding checklist item: include numeric/currency/guided-detok smoke for any adapter trained on financial text.
mira: agreed. closing this thread; will update HYDRA-589 with partial-merge results and detok perf numbers. :spiral_note_pad:
